title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

title: Consensys to split into MetaMask and institutional blockchain company

title: U.S. Bank tests proprietary stablecoin in cross-border Stellar transaction

title: Hunter Biden’s laptop controversy gets a memecoin afterlife

title: Trade groups seek to block Illinois crypto tax before January effective date
summary: Following on their earlier lawsuit, CCI and the Blockchain Association seek to block Illinois’ 0.2% crypto tax, arguing it is unconstitutional and would impose costly compliance burdens.

title: Tether, Fasanara launch $400M private credit fund targeting $3B
summary: The evergreen fund will use USDT infrastructure to support asset-backed lending through fintech platforms in more than 60 countries.

title: German finance ministry proposes 25% crypto tax starting 2028: Report
summary: The German Ministry of Finance is reportedly seeking to impose a 25% tax on cryptocurrencies, departing from current laws that make crypto gains tax-free after one year of holding.
